Established fleet-wide test-interface-zeroing pattern (gate-8 ruling + M279/M283/M207 precedent): a real progressive jackpot store the current testspin interface forces to 0; the sample correctly shows 0. Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface populates it the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The reported RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive). NOT a per-machine investigation — fleet pattern, one-time recorded.
